# reversi rule port

Source: https://github.com/kaahanmotwani/Cinder-Othello

Pinned commit: `f1cc4463c73d744ff1b7f7d14e5f9a237215653e`

License: MIT, full text retained in LICENSE.

IsMoveValid, FlipPieces, InBounds and GetValidMoves from logic.cc are adapted to a fixed integer board with bounds-safe iteration. Cinder graphics, audio and the upstream scoreboard database are not bundled. CipherChat provides automatic passes, terminal scoring, Qt rendering and chat room synchronization.

The upstream_*.txt files retain the uncompiled source snapshots used by this port. No npm, Cinder, upstream server or external game website is required at runtime.
